However correction lesson says: If also obtains profit (i.e., buys at low price and gains), then also "犯罪所得收益". In this case, he bought for 1400, value 4800, so he got benefit (difference). The lesson: "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪" vs "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得, 犯罪所得收益". The example earlier: first example about high speed purchase: they labeled "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". So we should include both. The prosecution says "隐瞒犯罪所得罪". But correction says need also include "犯罪所得收益". So final answer: [罪名]掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得;犯罪所得收益<eoa>
